title: precheck flags a committed item whose check is the intake --status of a time-windowed detector and names when it can first pass
goal: backlog.py precheck SP warns of a committed item whose check or repro is backlog.py intake --status FP of a time-windowed detector (repeats: the running ISO week; trailers: the last 7 days), naming when it can first pass, so the operator moves or gates the item before the start. Answers the SP-qzip6qar land, test and ops hygiene retrospective: ST-mwtm7r7b, ST-evlez5mw, ST-52x5bpab (2026-W41 repeats) and BG-jbn2z4mt (7-day trailers window) were found unpassable only during the run.

run:
import subprocess,sys,tempfile,os,datetime
sys.path.insert(0,'_tools')
import bl_intake
live=os.getcwd()
t=tempfile.mkdtemp();subprocess.run(['git','init','-q',t],check=True);os.makedirs(t+'/kb/_self/backlog')
b=[sys.executable,live+'/_tools/backlog.py','--root',t]
def run(*a):
    r=subprocess.run(b+list(a),capture_output=True,text=True,cwd=t);assert r.returncode==0,(a,r.stdout,r.stderr);return r.stdout
sp=run('new','sprint','--title','S').split()[2]
y,w,_=datetime.date.today().isocalendar()
ids=[]
for n,fp in (('repeats',bl_intake.fingerprint('repeats',f'{y}-W{w:02d} grep')),('trailers',bl_intake.fingerprint('trailers',bl_intake.WHOLE_KEY))):
    ids.append(run('new','story','--title','T '+n,'--sprint',sp,'--goal','g','--check','python3 _tools/backlog.py intake --status '+fp).split()[2])
out=run('precheck',sp).splitlines()
ok=[any(i in l and 'warning' in l and k in l for l in out) for i,k in zip(ids,('week','7 days'))]
print(out,ok);sys.exit(0 if all(ok) else 1)

notes: Premise: python3 _tools/backlog.py precheck SP-qzip6qar style runs each check once and only warns of one that passes already; python3 _tools/backlog.py intake --status <fingerprint of repeats key '<running ISO week> <class>'> exits 1 until the week ends, and the trailers fingerprint (key open) until the commits leave the 7-day window, with no warning from precheck now (the story's check plants both and shows no warning line). The fingerprint is a hash, so precheck finds the detector by matching the item's fingerprint against bl_intake.collect's findings or the detectors' keys.
